summary: Specification of the single `grant` authority table (resource_type × operation × scope as the permission floor; tools/fields/record-rights are derived projections) plus the closed scope lattice — hierarchy-nodes (subtree containment), tag-sets (set inclusion), numeric intervals (canonical containment), and scope-sets — with a decidable structural partial order, a closed meet, and a write-time subset check that makes monotonic narrowing (no self-elevation) provable. Free-form predicate scopes are owner-only/non-delegable; grant create/revoke are first-class audit-floor events. Design-only: DDL is T-0053, the resolver/PDP is T-0021, the audit floor is T-0016. 15 CI-checkable acceptance criteria, the lattice core fully static-now.
functional: FR-1 single `grant` authority table; floor = resource_type × operation × scope; record-rights/tools/fields are derived, no second subsystem; T-0013 tenant table

FR-2 grant row shape (role_id principal, resource_type, resource_facet?, operation incl guarded verbs, scope lattice element, constraint?, delegable, granted_by, validity window); binds to UUIDs not slugs
FR-3 closed scope lattice: elements (hierarchy-node, tag-set, numeric-interval, scope-set), decidable partial order ⊑, meet ⊓ (GLB), bottom ⊥
FR-4 closure property: domain closed under ⊓ ⇒ ⊑ decidable+total ⇒ narrowing provable; delegation chains monotonically narrow by construction
FR-5 write-time subset check: a delegated grant is rejected unless child.scope ⊑ granter.scope (and facet/constraint non-widening); owner is the un-parented lattice root
FR-6 free-form predicate scopes are owner-only and delegable=false (never the parent of a delegation)
FR-7 grant issuance/revocation emit first-class audit-floor events (actor, subject role, capability, scope, proposed_by/confirmed_by) — obligation only; ledger is T-0016
FR-8 revocation removes capability on the read-path (physically absent), not just UI
non_functional: NF-1 single authority, single subsystem (no parallel record-ACL)
NF-4 tenant isolation inherited from T-0013
NF-6 resolver-agnostic contract (table+algebra+gate, not the PDP)
out_of_scope: SQL DDL / migrations / RLS policy bodies for `grant` (T-0053)
PDP / grant_resolver runtime: resolution, masking, action-time binding, caching (T-0021/E2.5)
audit floor table + hash-chain + append-only enforcement (T-0016/E2.8); only the emit obligation is fixed here
role / assignment tables + org/admin scope (T-0022/E3.2, T-0017/E3.1); admin-scope narrowing is E3.3
structural grant editor UI + LLM-proposes/human-confirms (T-0030/E3.4, T-0039/E3.5)
toolset resolution / mcp_tool registry / effect-resource verification (T-0043/E5.3, T-0034/E4.4)
BPMN linter / engine state-mutation guard / opaque handles (T-0027/T-0028/T-0015)

acceptance_criteria.text: `grant` is a registered T-0013 tenant table: in known_tenant_tables fixture; live FORCE RLS = (true,true); no tenant context ⇒ count 0 (default-DENY)
grant floor (role_id, resource_type, operation, scope) all NOT NULL; NULL on any ⇒ constraint violation; TS Grant type mirrors FR-2 columns (compile-checked)
⊑ is decidable+total over admissible scopes: subsetEq(a,b) returns a boolean for the fixture matrix (never throws/unknown) and matches the FR-3 truth table
hierarchy-node subset: descendant ⊑ parent true; disjoint subtree or ancestor (wider) ⇒ false
tag-set & interval subset: {a,b}⊑{a,b,c} true / {a,d} false; [10,40]⊑[0,50] true / [10,60] false; mismatched axis ⇒ false
scope-set subset: element ⊑ set iff fits one member; A⊑B iff every member of A ⊑ B; an escaping member ⇒ false
meet ⊓ closure: meet(x,y) returns an admissible element (node/tags/interval/set/⊥), never an arbitrary predicate; disjoint node⊓node=⊥; interval overlap or ⊥; tags=intersection
canonical form: accepted scope is canonical (interval lo≤hi; tags de-duped; set flattened, no nested/redundant members); subsetEq/meet deterministic regardless of member order

write-time subset gate: child.scope ⊑ granter.scope (non-widening facet/constraint) ⇒ accepted; not-a-subset (node/tag/interval widening, escaping set member) ⇒ rejected at write-time before persistence
owner-only free-form, non-delegable: non-owner free-form-scope mint rejected; free-form-scope forced delegable=false; delegation off a free-form parent rejected
single subsystem: static lint asserts no second authority/record-ACL/field-visibility table; record-rights are only grant.operation × grant.scope
grant binds to UUIDs not slugs: every node_id in grant.scope is a ResourceRef/org-tree UUID; slug rename does not change reach
validity window = capability: out-of-window grant confers zero capability in the evaluation helper; in-window confers its capability
audit obligation: grant create/revoke emit an event (actor, subject role, capability, scope, proposed_by/confirmed_by); static lint asserts every create/revoke site emits
tenant isolation of grants: context=A ⇒ count of tenant-B grants = 0; subset check runs inside withTenant; a tenant-B grant can never parent a tenant-A delegation
